description: List guests at an event you manage, including the latest signups/newest additions. Free RSVPs, guest-list adds, comps and paid tickets — with name, email, phone, category, plus-ones, source (rsvp/guest_list/paid/comp) and check-in status, plus totals per source and the checked-in count. Cancelled/refunded tickets left out; staff only with include_staff. Optional category/source filters; limit selects latest N ticket records (1-500). Newest first by createdAt (ISO UTC), unknown dates last. newestOrderComplete and coverageNote disclose missing dates/incomplete scans; totalIsExact covers summary counts. Multiple tickets can belong to one person. Requires event_id; you must be a host. Read-only.
name: list_guests
title: List Guests
